summary.business_type: Personal brand / portfolio with engineering blog (Publisher, very small)
top_findings: No robots.txt or sitemap.xml (both 404); site not submitted to Search Console or Bing Webmaster Tools
No metadataBase or canonical tags; four text/plain twins return 200 without a canonical signal
No JSON-LD (Person, ProfilePage, BlogPosting) and no rel="me"; off-site profiles don't tie the name 'Luan Fabri' to 'luannzin'
No Open Graph or Twitter metadata and no og:image, despite Share and Ask AI buttons
Post content ships inside <div hidden id="S:1">: blank without JS, mobile lab LCP about 4.1 s
quick_wins: Link rel=canonical headers on the Markdown twins in next.config.ts
GitHub profile name 'Luan Fabri' with the website field set; npm author and homepage for better-intl

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: 308 redirects to the canonical www host
TTFB 60-75 ms with Vercel cache HIT

findings.title: robots.txt and sitemap.xml return 404
findings.description: No app/robots.ts or app/sitemap.ts; sitemap_discovery found none.
findings.recommendation: Add src/app/robots.ts with a Sitemap line, and src/app/sitemap.ts listing / and each post from getPosts().

findings.title: No metadataBase or canonical tags
findings.description: layout.tsx and the post generateMetadata set no canonical.
findings.recommendation: Add metadataBase in layout.tsx; set alternates.canonical in page.tsx and the post generateMetadata, not in the layout.

findings.title: Markdown twins lack a canonical signal
findings.description: /index.md, /llms.txt, /writing/<slug>.md and /writing/<slug>/md return 200 text/plain with no Link or X-Robots-Tag header.
findings.recommendation: Send Link: <html-url>; rel="canonical" headers from next.config.ts headers().

findings.title: Only HSTS among security headers
findings.description: No nosniff, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options or Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Add them in next.config.ts headers().

findings.title: External favicon
findings.description: github.com/luannzin.png?size=64 302-redirects; it is 64 px, not a multiple of 48; /favicon.ico is 404.
findings.recommendation: Add a self-hosted src/app/icon.png and apple-icon.png.

findings.title: 404 page has two <title> tags
findings.description: The default not-found page plus layout metadata.
findings.recommendation: Add src/app/not-found.tsx with its own metadata.

findings.title: /writing returns 404
findings.description: The breadcrumb label suggests an index page that doesn't exist.
findings.recommendation: Redirect /writing to /#writing until there are about 5 posts.

findings.title: Homepage is thin
findings.description: About 110 words, with no contact route or location.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-5 true facts and an email link; keep index.md/route.ts in step.

findings.title: Only one post
findings.description: better-intl and echo each get only a one-line card.
findings.recommendation: Publish a better-intl vs next-intl post, echo build notes, and multi-tenant Next.js lessons.

findings.title: No answer-first summary
findings.description: The post doesn't open with a quotable statement of the technique.
findings.recommendation: Open with 2-3 self-contained sentences.

findings.title: Comma splice in bio
findings.description: "front-end engineer at Loopscape, I build..."
findings.recommendation: "...at Loopscape, where I build..." in both page.tsx and index.md/route.ts.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Descriptive internal links between home and the post

findings.title: Post title and description miss search terms
findings.description: The description is 43 characters; 'generative', 'PRNG' and 'javascript' appear 0 times in the prose.
findings.recommendation: Add an SEO title, a 140-155 character description, and name each technique in the prose and headings.

findings.title: Home title is the name only
findings.description: <title>Luan Fabri</title>
findings.recommendation: 'Luan Fabri · Front-end engineer'

findings.title: Byline only in the footer
findings.description: Author not shown near the post title.
findings.recommendation: Add 'By Luan Fabri' to the date line.

findings.title: No Person, ProfilePage or WebSite on home
findings.description: 0 JSON-LD, Microdata or RDFa blocks.
findings.recommendation: Add a @graph with WebSite and ProfilePage; mainEntity is a Person with @id, alternateName, worksFor and sameAs.

findings.title: No BlogPosting on the post
findings.description: No author, headline or datePublished markup.
findings.recommendation: Add BlogPosting with author referencing the Person @id, plus image from the OG image.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList
findings.description: The breadcrumb is visible but not marked up.
findings.recommendation: Add a two-item BreadcrumbList.

findings.title: Post content hidden behind a Suspense boundary
findings.description: All of <main> sits in <div hidden id="S:1">, revealed by $RC about 83 KB into the HTML. Post FCP 0.52 s vs home 0.22 s; mobile lab LCP 4.09-4.15 s.
findings.recommendation: Await params outside the Suspense (or remove it) with dynamicParams = false; read the Next 16 docs first.

findings.title: High TBT and JS weight
findings.description: Mobile TBT 465-514 ms (home) and 668-1248 ms (post); WebGL scene code and full motion on home; 8 canvases hydrate on the post.
findings.recommendation: Static thumbnail on home, lazy-init canvases, LazyMotion.

findings.title: Text and enter animations start hidden
findings.description: TextReveal writes inline opacity:0 and blur; 12-15 non-composited blur animations with 400-800 ms delays.
findings.recommendation: CSS-first reveal behind prefers-reduced-motion; drop the blur; cap delays above the fold.

findings.title: Remote avatar is the home LCP element
findings.description: Served from github.com, with a fade-in.
findings.recommendation: Self-host the avatar in src/assets.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: All tested AI crawlers get 200 with full HTML

findings.title: Name not tied to handle or domain off-site
findings.description: GitHub name is 'luan' with no blog field; better-intl on npm has no author or homepage; useecho.dev doesn't name him; no Wikidata.
findings.recommendation: Update the profiles, add npm author and homepage, add rel="me" links.

findings.title: Not submitted to Bing
findings.description: Bing's index feeds ChatGPT Search and Copilot.
findings.recommendation: Submit the sitemap to Bing Webmaster Tools.

findings.title: No community footprint
findings.description: No Reddit, Hacker News or YouTube mentions.
findings.recommendation: Share the post on r/generative, HN and dev.to.

findings.title: llms.txt summary too thin
findings.description: The summary line doesn't identify the person.
findings.recommendation: Expand it with name, handle, role and projects (confirm facts first).

categories.name: Images
what_works: Canvas hero has role=img and an aria-label

findings.title: No og:image or twitter:image
findings.description: The post cover is runtime canvas art, so there's no raster to share.
findings.recommendation: Add opengraph-image.tsx at the root and under writing/[slug].

findings.title: echo logo lazy-loaded in the first viewport
findings.description: It's small, so the impact is minor.
findings.recommendation: Mark it as priority or leave it.

phases.name: Phase 1: Foundations
items: Link rel=canonical headers on Markdown twins
Deploy; submit to Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Ship post HTML visible (no hidden Suspense boundary)
Post SEO title, description and wording
CSS-first entrance animations; self-host the avatar

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: 2-3 posts: better-intl vs next-intl, echo build notes, multi-tenant Next.js
JS weight: static thumbnail, lazy canvases, LazyMotion
Hygiene: security headers, icon.png, not-found.tsx, byline, pre tabindex

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Configure a Google API key for CrUX field data
